title: Financial Market Infrastructures Evolution in a Tokenized Economy
title_zh: 代币化经济中金融市场基础设施的演进
authors: Yaiza Cabedo & Mr. Tommaso Mancini-Griffoli & Fabian Schär & Nicolas Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-07-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines how tokenization and distributed ledger technology may transform Financial Market Infrastructures (FMIs) by enabling smart contracts to perform a growing share of functions traditionally undertaken by central securities depositories, central counterparties, and trade repositories. It argues that while record-keeping, settlement, collateral management, and reporting can increasingly be executed on-chain, key functions requiring legal certainty, governance, accountability, and discretion remain institutional in nature. The analysis assesses which activities across issuance, clearing, settlement, and reporting can migrate to code, where limitations persist, and how risks evolve in tokenized environments. It finds that tokenization is more likely to reconfigure than eliminate FMIs, creating new efficiencies while introducing novel operational and governance risks. The most plausible outcome is a hybrid FMI model in which technology and institutions jointly provide the trust, resilience, and oversight required for financial stability.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨代币化与分布式账本技术如何通过使智能合约承担中央证券存管机构、中央对手方及交易数据库等传统金融基础设施（FMIs）中日益增多的职能，从而推动其变革。研究指出，尽管记录保存、结算、抵押品管理及报告等环节可逐步迁移至链上执行，但涉及法律确定性、治理、问责及自由裁量权的关键职能仍具有制度属性。本文系统评估了发行、清算、结算及报告等环节中哪些活动可迁移至代码执行、现存局限性所在，以及代币化环境下风险演变特征。研究发现，代币化更可能重构而非消除金融基础设施，在创造新效率的同时引入新型操作与治理风险。最可能的结果是形成混合型金融基础设施模式——技术与机构共同提供金融稳定所需的信任、韧性及监管能力。

title: Beyond the Degree: Fertility Outcomes of ‘First in Family’ Graduates
title_zh: 大规模出发铁人三项中的跟风与搭便车：基于COVID-19出发形式断点的证据
authors: Adamecz, Anna, Lovász, Anna, Vujić, Sunčica
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines the link between higher education and fertility, with particular attention to the role of intergenerational educational mobility in shaping this relationship. Drawing on data from the 1970 British Cohort Study, we estimate differences in completed fertility across three groups: first-in-family university graduates (FiF), graduates with at least one university-educated parent (non-FiF graduates), and individuals who did not attend university (non-graduates). Our findings show that although graduate women generally have fewer children than non-graduates, this gap is primarily driven by FiF graduates. FiF women have lower fertility than both non-FiF graduates and non-graduates, who exhibit similar fertility patterns. The fertility gap between FiF and non-FiF graduates emerges after age 35, mainly on the extensive margin: FiF women are more likely to remain childless, but those who become mothers have an average number of children similar to non-FiF graduates. Similar patterns are observed for men, however, the gaps are smaller and not statistically significant. We identify child-related preferences, self-esteem, and exposure to maternal employment during childhood as potential drivers of the relationship between FiF status and fertility. In contrast, labour market outcomes, financial constraints, partnership status, and health outcomes do not appear to contribute to the FiF fertility gap. These findings highlight key considerations for policies aimed at supporting both intergenerational mobility and fertility.
abstract_zh: 在集体出发游泳赛段中跟游所产生的流体力学成本优势会转移至自行车与跑步阶段，并表现为相对排名的变化。本文以跨赛段排名提升作为搭便车行为的反向代理指标，基于以2020年为中心的十年期运动员×赛事面板数据，研究其决定因素——2020年新冠疫情应对政策将集体出发改为间隔出发，从机制上限制了跟游行为。通过构建紧凑的两阶段竞赛模型（将跟游作为乘数型成本转移因子纳入自行车-跑步阶段）来组织预测。识别策略结合了混合OLS回归、运动员与赛事固定效应，以及以2019/2020年为断点的锐化回归断点设计。2020年前搭便车现象显著，2020年急剧下降（局部线性RDD估计值约为-31个排名位次；局部立方估计值约为-92），此后仅部分恢复。游泳能力较弱的运动员和跟游位置更靠后的选手获益最大，性别差异较小，且收益随游泳组规模扩大而增加（估计对数-对数弹性约为0.43）。因此，2020年的冲击相当于收缩了搭便车的可行集，其恢复呈现非均衡特征而非全面复苏。

title: Domestic Demand or Trade Retaliation? China's Policy Responses to U.S. Tariff Hikes
title_zh: 国内需求还是贸易报复？中国对美国加征关税的政策回应
authors: Zhijie Jia, Shiyan Wen, Rongxin Wu
abstract: Rising deglobalization has increased external uncertainty for the global economy. This paper develops a China–US Trade Equilibrium (CUTE) model that integrates monetary mechanisms and Hicksian welfare decomposition to examine the effects of U.S. tariff hikes on China and the U.S., as well as China's policy responses. A key contribution is the comparison of policy responses under identical policy costs. The results show that the direct macroeconomic impact of U.S. tariffs on China is modest, reflecting limited trade exposure and strong substitution effects, while broad tariffs generate larger welfare losses for the America through price increases and real income erosion. The reaction directly supporting household income and consumption yield substantially higher welfare returns than trade retaliation, government spending or monetary easing, as tariffs reduce real purchasing power. We suggest within the institutional settings considered, prioritizing household‐based demand support is a more effective response to external tariff shocks than retaliatory trade measures.
abstract_zh: 去全球化趋势加剧了全球经济的外部不确定性。本文构建了一个整合货币机制与希克斯福利分解的中美贸易均衡（CUTE）模型，用以考察美国加征关税对中国和美国的影响，以及中国的政策应对。本文的关键贡献在于，在相同政策成本条件下比较了不同政策应对的效果。研究结果表明，美国关税对中国的直接宏观经济影响较为温和，这反映了有限的贸易敞口和较强的替代效应；而广泛性关税则通过价格上涨和实际收入侵蚀，给美国带来更大的福利损失。相较于贸易报复、政府支出或货币宽松政策，直接支持家庭收入和消费的应对措施能产生显著更高的福利回报，原因在于关税削弱了实际购买力。我们建议，在所考虑的体制环境下，优先采取基于家庭的需求支持政策，是应对外部关税冲击比报复性贸易措施更为有效的策略。

title: Strategic Submissions: An Analysis of Supplemental Drug Approvals
title_zh: 策略性提交：补充药物批准的分析
authors: Pierre Dubois, Elissa Philip Gentry, Tuba Tunçel
abstract: Off‐label use regulation has the potential to change pharmaceutical firms' behavior and—consequently—affect patient welfare. We investigate the impact of changes in off‐label regulation on pharmaceutical firms' behavior in seeking formal marketing approval for supplemental uses. In 2012, a US court decision protected truthful off‐label promotion, providing pharmaceutical companies more leeway to promote off‐label uses of their drug. Using a unique data set of pharmaceutical firms' research and development projects, we exploit this regulatory change to understand how firms react to government policies. Results demonstrate that the hazard of approval declined for supplemental uses, relative to original uses, after the policy change. Patent protection, potential market size, and competition are also important determinants of the hazard of approval. These results have implications not only for innovation policy but for the creation of high‐quality data for certain indications.
abstract_zh: 超说明书用药监管可能改变制药企业的行为，进而影响患者福利。本文研究了超说明书用药监管变化对制药企业寻求补充用途正式上市许可行为的影响。2012年美国一项法院裁决保护了真实的超说明书推广行为，使制药公司获得更大空间推广其药物的超说明书用途。我们利用制药企业研发项目的独特数据集，借助这一监管变化来理解企业如何应对政府政策。结果表明，政策变化后，补充用途相较于原始用途的获批风险有所下降。专利保护、潜在市场规模和竞争也是影响获批风险的重要因素。这些发现不仅对创新政策具有启示意义，也对特定适应症高质量数据的生成产生影响。
